import json
pts = json.load(open("/tmp/spring_pts.json"))
data = [(p["z"], p["ft"]["fz"]) for p in pts]

def lstsq(seg):
    n = len(seg)
    z = [p[0] for p in seg]
    f = [p[1] for p in seg]
    mz = sum(z)/n
    mf = sum(f)/n
    varz = sum((zi-mz)**2 for zi in z)
    cov = sum((zi-mz)*(fi-mf) for zi,fi in zip(z,f))
    b = cov/varz
    a = mf - b*mz
    resid = [fi - (a+b*zi) for zi,fi in zip(z,f)]
    rmse = (sum(r*r for r in resid)/n)**0.5
    return -b, a, rmse, list(zip(z,f,resid))

for lo, hi, label in [(5,13,"5-13"), (5,12,"5-12"), (6,13,"6-13"), (6,12,"6-12"), (5,11,"5-11"), (7,13,"7-13"), (6,11,"6-11"), (4,13,"4-13")]:
    k, a, rmse, rows = lstsq(data[lo:hi+1])
    print(f"{label}: k_fit={k:.4f} N/mm  rmse={rmse:.4f}  zero-force z={-a/(-k) if k else None:.3f} wait")
    # F = a + b z, b=-k, F=0 => z = -a/b = a/k
    print(f"   contact_z_extrap={a/k:.4f}")
    for zi,fi,ri in rows:
        print(f"   z={zi:.4f} F={fi:.3f} resid={ri:+.4f}")

print("\nincremental:")
for i in range(1, len(data)):
    dz = data[i][0]-data[i-1][0]
    df = data[i][1]-data[i-1][1]
    if abs(dz)>0.05:
        print(f"  {i-1}->{i}: dz={dz:.4f} df={df:.3f} k={-df/dz:.3f}")

# old c_seat correction
for k in [12.7, 12.8, 12.9, 13.0, 13.1]:
    c = 0.0009
    k_corr = 1/(1/k - c)
    print(f"k_fit={k} -> k_corr={k_corr:.4f} (old c)")

    z = [p[0] for p in seg]

    mz = sum(z)/n

def probe(x, y, z_start=105, z_min=30):
    r = workcell.call("arm", "move", str(x), str(y), str(z_start))
    if not r.ok:
        print(f"MOVE FAIL {x},{y}: {r.text}")
        # clear protective stop?

        return None
    z = r.data.get("tip_mm", [None,None,None])[2] if r.data else None
    # descend

        if not st.ok:

            print(workcell.call("arm","status").text)

        z = st.data["z_mm"]
        fz = st.data["fz_N"]
        if fz > 0.4:

            break
        if z < z_min:
            break
    # fine approach if we overshot force

    # if light contact, step -0.2 a couple times? for height map, approximate contact z is enough

        workcell.call("arm", "move", str(x), str(y), str(z_start))
    result = {"x": x, "y": y, "hit": hit, "tip": tip}
